# Code map (generated, do not edit by hand)

> `npm run map` scans the engine source. Read when needed, after `AI.md` and the game's `GAMEMAP.md`; API details are in `API.md` and `api/<module>.md`. Paths are relative to the package.

## Modules (installed with engine.use)

Requires, optional, stage, run order, params, ops, saves and time model of each module: `npx threedog catalog` (and `catalog <module>`); only the file is listed here.

| cameraRig (followCamera()) | modules/camera/FollowCamera.js |
| cameraRig (rtsCamera()) | modules/camera/RtsCamera.js |
| terrain | modules/terrain/index.js |
